description: Rejects asserting that Conjecture 2 holds universally across all Complex Hadamard Matrices. The isolated Tao matrix S_6 = F_3 (x) F_2 fails both clause (a) and clause (b) on 20/20 permutations and serves as a fail-closed negative control.
negative_fixture: Conjecture 2 is a universal property of all 6x6 complex Hadamard matrices.
positive_fixture: Tao S_6 contains 0 entries equal to -1 and fails Conjecture 2 on 20/20 permutations as a strict negative control.
